scope: One read-only provider inventory, owned run ledger, systemd timer, and EC2 MuseTalk registry checkpoint. No GPU, service, configuration, create, or destroy action.
label: musetalk-r5-3090-dev-20261008

cumulative_network_provider_fields.note: The names indicate provider billed traffic counters, not dollar amounts. Retrieved official API/CLI documentation did not establish the raw counter unit. Do not divide by an assumed factor or present these as finalized transfer cost.

actual_billed_status: Not available as a finalized per-instance monetary total in the inspected inventory response; invoices were not queried

estimates_not_invoices.formula: run_age_hours * observed dph_total; assumes billing begins at provider start and unchanged observed rate
estimates_not_invoices.checkpoint_reserve_formula: elapsed * conservative_hourly + full transfer reserve + full extra storage reserve + uncertainty reserve
estimates_not_invoices.caveat: A conservative planning allowance, not a verified invoice or unconditional upper bound: actual traffic must remain within the reserved 100 GB each direction, and uninspected additional providers/storage charges are excluded.

approved_budget_and_owned_ledger.remaining_budget_caveat: Subtract any other run reservations or actual shared experiment expenses before new spending. This checkpoint does not release any reservation.

expiry.note: Inactive service is expected while its active timer waits for the future deadline; this is not proof that a future destroy has occurred.
